description: Frontend: single shared recommendation fetcher (dedupe, cache, abort, stale-ignore, Retry-After backoff with jitter, capped retries) and strict separation so only an authoritative room lookup (REST /state 404 ROOM_NOT_FOUND or WS ERROR ROOM_NOT_FOUND) can show Room Not Found. Depends on FEAT-001 only for error codes/Retry-After header, which the frontend should also tolerate when absent.
steps: api.ts: add retryAfterMs to ApiError, parse Retry-After (seconds or HTTP date) on non-ok responses.

New frontend/src/services/recommendation.service.ts shared fetcher per plan.md Design decisions; replace auction.store.ts lines ~106-112 timer with fetcher calls only when activationId or currentBid changes; add recommendationStatus; cancel on leaveAuction and when status != RUNNING. Edit auction.store.ts with minimal str_replace (other workflow edits it).

auction.store.ts: add roomMissing; REST getState catch (line ~80) sets roomMissing only for status 404 + code ROOM_NOT_FOUND, otherwise keeps snapshot, sets non-blocking notice and one shared capped backoff retry; WS ERROR ROOM_NOT_FOUND sets roomMissing; other ERROR events never imply missing room.
room/[roomCode]/page.tsx and auction/[roomCode]/page.tsx: show Room Not Found only when roomMissing (or no room and a real lookup error); AISuggestionPanel shows non-blocking unavailable state.
Verify existing reconnect (websocket.service.ts) via tests; change only if a test fails.

Tests: frontend/tests/recommendation-fetch.mjs (bounded fetch count, 429 Retry-After capped retries, recommendation 404/500/network keep state and roomMissing false, authoritative 404 sets roomMissing, 500/429/network on /state preserve snapshot, reconnect resync with no duplicates); follow tests/api-client.mjs and tests/reconnect-protocol.mjs esbuild pattern; register wherever type-boundary.mjs runs tests if applicable.
acceptance_criteria: 50 identical ROOM_STATE events cause at most 1 recommendation request
429 with Retry-After causes at most 3 automatic retries then unavailable state; snapshot, timer and bids unchanged
recommendation 404/500/network never sets roomMissing nor bidErrorNotice
REST state 404 ROOM_NOT_FOUND sets roomMissing true
npm run typecheck and npx next build pass
findings: Implemented shared RecommendationFetcher (dedupe by room|activation|bid, 1.5s throttle, AbortController, stale ignore, Retry-After + exponential backoff with jitter, max 3 retries on 429, one retry on 5xx/network, none on 404/409). Store gained roomMissing/syncNotice/recommendationStatus; only REST /state 404 ROOM_NOT_FOUND or WS ERROR ROOM_NOT_FOUND set roomMissing; other /state failures keep state and retry (cap 5). Pages show Room Not Found only on roomMissing. Tests: node tests/recommendation-fetch.mjs PASS; npm run typecheck PASS; npx next build PASS; reconnect-protocol, api-client, websocket-protocol, auction-redesign-ui, connection-ui, skip-vote-ui, recall-ui PASS. Pre-existing failures unrelated: tests/retention-ui.mjs (fails identically with my changes stashed), tests/auction-ui.mjs (node strip-types error on backend auth.service.ts). Reconnect code unchanged.
